scope.tps: All-node persisted common-ancestor net transaction growth between exact 2s/12s head observations; single short run per variant.
scope.failed_baseline: An invalid K=0 window leaves its formal TPS and every same-rate relative improvement null; no diagnostic or historical value substitutes for it.
scope.state_audit: Full state objects include the chain head. Full-state/head inequality alone does not establish an account balance or nonce error; inspect local account audit counts and account_state_hash_variants separately.
scope.latency: Scheduled arrival to first full all-node identical-position observation, checked on final persisted canonical ledgers; includes batching, transmission, polling and RPC.
scope.diagnostics: Load-process cumulative counters through stop, including warmup/drain/stop; not the exact ten-second TPS window. Per-node ratios are calculated before node aggregation.
scope.step_comparison: K>1 also uses current-round scheduling; comparisons measure the complete step mode.
scope.privacy: Field allowlist; no host identifiers or addresses, arbitrary errors, logs, account records, original argv paths or credentials are emitted.
